input.story: As a reader, I want a navigation bar with a sidebar menu and breadcrumbs so that I can move around the site.
input.context: A documentation site. The admin link is role-based.

criteria.text: The sidebar highlights the item for the page the reader is on
Breadcrumbs show the path to the current page, with a hint when the reader moves their mouse cursor over a step
The menu opens and closes with the menu button on a phone
The current item is shown in bold
A reader without the admin role is not shown the admin link and cannot open it by URL

test_cases.title: The item for the open page is highlighted
No other sidebar item is highlighted at the same time
Breadcrumbs show the path to the current page
test_cases.expected: The breadcrumbs read Home › Guides › Getting started

test_cases.title: A breadcrumb step shows its hint on hover
test_cases.expected: A hint appears naming the Guides section

test_cases.title: The menu button opens the menu on a phone
steps: Open the site on a 390px wide screen

test_cases.title: The menu closes again on the second press
steps: Open the menu on a phone

test_cases.title: The current item is bold
steps: Compare the Guides item with its neighbours
test_cases.expected: The Guides item is rendered in bold and the others are not

test_cases.title: A reader without the admin role is refused the admin URL
test_cases.expected: The page shows: You do not have access to this page

test_cases.title: A reader without the admin role is not shown the admin link
An admin sees the admin link
The API refuses an action whose button is hidden for this role
steps: Sign in as a reader and confirm the admin button is not shown
Call the admin action's endpoint directly with that session
Call the same endpoint as an admin
test_cases.expected: The reader's call is refused with 403 and the admin's succeeds

test_cases.title: The menu can be used by keyboard alone with a visible focus ring
steps: Press Tab from the top of the page through every menu item
Open the menu on a phone and Tab through it
test_cases.expected: Every item takes focus in order, shows a visible focus ring, and Enter opens it

test_cases.title: A role change takes effect without signing out
steps: Sign in as an admin in one browser and as that admin's colleague in another
Change the colleague's role to reader
Reload an admin page in the colleague's open session
test_cases.expected: The revoked role takes effect immediately: the admin page is refused in the existing session, without signing out and in again
test_cases.test_data: role=admin demoted to reader while signed in
